title: Preview batch: hitungan blok-vs-baris + detail tolak per-blok / Batch preview: block-vs-line counts plus per-block reject detail
summary: ID: Preview BatchForm menampilkan '{count} blok dari {lines} baris' dan tiap blok ditolak menyebut nomor blok 1-based + panjang karakter + hint split. / EN: The BatchForm preview shows '{count} blocks from {lines} lines' and each rejected block names its 1-based block number plus character length plus a split hint.
problem_before: ID: Preview tak menjelaskan pemisahan blok vs baris; pesan tolak tak menyebut blok mana yang bermasalah. / EN: The preview did not explain block-vs-line splitting; rejection messages did not say which block was problematic.
solution: ID: Helper murni countBatchLines + tipe rejectedItem (nomor blok 1-based, panjang char); notice submit ikut format sama; perbaiki hardcoded ID + index 0-based. / EN: Pure countBatchLines helper plus a rejectedItem type (1-based block number, char length); the submit notice follows the same format; fixed hardcoded IDs plus 0-based indexes.
reason: ID: Diagnosis input batch 50-blok butuh penunjuk posisi yang tepat. / EN: Diagnosing 50-block batch input needs precise position pointers.
user_impact: ID: Pengguna tahu persis blok mana ditolak dan mengapa, plus saran split. / EN: Users know exactly which block was rejected and why, plus split advice.
tech_impact: ID: Helper validasi murni + 4 test baru; tanpa perubahan API/DB. / EN: Pure validation helper plus 4 new tests; no API/DB change.
